# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Crude slips toward $84 as a supply glut outruns the Hormuz war premium](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 18, 2026. Oil is falling even with tankers still hitting mines in the Gulf. WTI traded near $84 and Brent near $92 this morning as record US output, rising inventories and higher Russian exports outweighed the Hormuz risk.
- [Midstream: Pipeline builders have proposed 46.5 Bcf/d of new US gas capacity this year](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Upstream: ExxonMobil commits $12.5 billion to Longtail, a gas and condensate play in Guyana](https://uticamidstream.com/#offshore)
- [Gas and LNG: European gas climbs back to 86 euros with storage far below normal](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Downstream: Refiners keep printing money as distillate stays scarce](https://uticamidstream.com/#downstream)
- [Cross-industry: Colorado becomes the seventh state to run its own CO2 storage permits](https://uticamidstream.com/#ccus)
